title: Vinyl Retreat - Pool & Gym - Walk to Broadway
description:
Welcome to Vinyl Retreat, a music-inspired Music Row stay with neon lights, record art, and bold design in every room. Spend laid-back afternoons by the heated pool, settle into the lobby lounge, or head out to explore. Browse The Gulch's boutiques and rooftop dining, or make your way to Broadway for live music, lively bars, and unforgettable nights. When the day winds down, then come back to the Vinyl Retreat to recharge and get ready to do it all again.

The space
⭐ Building Accommodations & Amenities:
- An easy 15-minute stroll to Broadway, where live music fills the air, neon lights glow, and every night turns into a memorable experience
- Unmatched location just 1 minute from Vanderbilt University and 3 minutes from Belmont University, placing you right in the center of campus life and nearby hotspots
- Heated pool with skyline views, perfect for soaking up the sun or winding down as the day fades (open year-round 8 AM to 10 PM, HOA discretion)
- Newly redesigned unit with a music-inspired look, including a custom neon sign, vinyl record art, bold statement walls, and handpicked furniture in every room
- Beautifully designed lobby lounge with comfortable seating and a game area, ideal for relaxing, connecting, or keeping the night going
- Fully equipped fitness and yoga center open from 5 AM to midnight, giving you the flexibility to move on your own schedule
- Pet-friendly community with a gated dog area and wash station, making it easy to bring your four-legged companion along
- Poolside loungers and cabanas available for private rentals, great for celebrations, gatherings, or adding something extra to your stay (inquire at booking)
- Secure building with elevator access for a smooth, convenient experience throughout your stay
- 24/7 front desk with hotel-style check-in, offering a seamless arrival and an elevated feel from the moment you step inside

🛋️ Living Area:
- Bright, open-concept layout with an easy, welcoming flow that makes it simple to relax and settle into your Nashville getaway
- Plush sofa and leather swivel chairs made for sinking in after a full day of exploring
- Glowing "Flashing Lights and Southern Nights" neon sign that sets the Nashville mood
- Smart TV for streaming movies, catching the big game, or adding a little background entertainment while you unwind
- Large windows that fill the space with plenty of natural light

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining:
- Fully equipped kitchen with everything you need to prepare meals, mix a drink, and enjoy a relaxed night at home
- Modern stainless steel appliances that keep the space polished, functional, and easy to use
- Complete appliance lineup featuring a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, 4-burner stove, microwave, and toaster
- Generous counter space for preparing ingredients, serving food, and keeping everything organized
- Dining table with seating for 4, ideal for home-cooked meals, takeout, or getting together before a night out
- Keurig coffee maker with coffee provided, perfect for slow mornings or a quick pick-me-up before heading back into Nashville
- Kitchen Starter Kit: 1 sponge, 2 paper towels, 2 regular coffees, 1 vanilla coffee, 1 decaf coffee, 4 condiments, 1 dish soap, and 2 teas

🛌 Bedrooms:
- Primary Bedroom: Queen bed with a padded headboard, built-in reading lights and bedside outlets, smart TV, built-in wardrobe, and an en-suite bathroom
- 2nd Bedroom: Queen bed with built-in reading lights and bedside outlets, smart TV, and an open closet with drawers
- Additional Sleeping Arrangement: 1 sleeper sofa in the living area

🛁 Bathrooms:
- Primary Bathroom: En-suite bathroom featuring a single vanity with backlit LED mirror, lighted makeup mirror, and a walk-in glass shower
- 2nd Bathroom: Single vanity with backlit LED mirror, lighted makeup mirror, and a walk-in glass shower

🚗 Parking:
- Paid street parking available
- Valet parking available

- Booking guests must be at least 21 years old.
- Same-day move-ins shall not be honored after 10 am Arizona Time.

- All guests with a confirmed criminal record shall be declined and asked to cancel the booking at their own expense.
- The guest agrees to provide identity authentication via a third-party platform operating for GoodNight Stay. They will authenticate the name, address, phone number, and photo ID verification. If this is not provided within 48 hours of booking, GoodNight Stay has the right to cancel the booking without penalty.

Before booking, please review the full property description and house rules to ensure this home is the right fit for your stay. By completing your reservation, you acknowledge that you have read the listing details and agree to our terms and conditions.
